analysis.reason: 최근 3거래일 연속 하락(-8.85%, -2.25%, -6.99%)으로 RSI가 40.3까지 하락하며 과매도 구간 진입. MACD 히스토그램은 개선 중이나 여전히 약세 수렴 상태 유지. 5일 평균 거래량 대비 1.4배 증가했으나 가격 하락을 막지 못함. 52주 저가($205.50) 대비 높은 위치이나 52주 고가($1255.00) 대비로는 58.6% 수준으로 하락 추세 지속.
analysis.reasonEn: Recent three consecutive trading days of decline (-8.85%, -2.25%, -6.99%) have pushed RSI down to 40.3, entering oversold territory. MACD histogram is improving but remains in a bearish convergence. Volume ratio is 1.40 (surge) compared to the 5-day average, but failed to halt the price decline. While at 58.6% of the 52-week high ($1255.00), the downtrend persists, though still well above the 52-week low ($205.50).

analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly RSI at 56.1 is neutral, while daily RSI at 40.3 is entering oversold. Weekly ADX at 50.4 indicates an overheated trend nearing exhaustion.

analysis.patternNoteEn: Recent three consecutive trading days of decline approach the lower Bollinger Band, signaling oversold conditions.
keyPoints: 최근 3거래일 연속 하락으로 RSI 40.3까지 하락, 과매도 구간 진입.
MACD 히스토그램 개선 중이나 약세 수렴 유지, 추세 전환 신호는 아직 미약.
거래량 1.4배 증가했으나 가격 하락 방어 실패, 매수세 유입 확인 필요.
keyPointsEn: RSI dropped to 40.3 after three consecutive days of decline, entering oversold territory.
MACD histogram is improving but maintains bearish convergence; trend reversal signal remains weak.
Volume surged 1.4x but failed to defend price, requiring confirmation of buying pressure.

analysis.riskNoteEn: This is a shock-driven decline in a non-trending phase (ADX 19.6), with potential for a rebound.
analysis.continuity: 4일 연속 관망 유지. 직전 판단(7월 28일) 대비 RSI가 39.9에서 40.3으로 소폭 상승했으나 여전히 과매도 구간에 머물러 있으며, MACD 약세 수렴도 유지되어 관망 기조를 이어간다.
analysis.continuityEn: Maintaining a 'watchful' stance for 4 consecutive days. Compared to the previous assessment (July 28th), RSI slightly increased from 39.9 to 40.3 but remains in oversold territory, and MACD bearish convergence persists, thus continuing the 'watchful' approach.
